# Paths the template has deleted, and that the fan-out sync must therefore
# delete from every derived repository.
#
# Deleting a file here is not enough on its own. Template-derived repositories
# have unrelated histories, so a merge has no base to tell "they deleted it"
# apart from "we added it" — the target keeps the file indefinitely. Listing it
# here is what actually retires it.
#
# This is an allowlist on purpose. The alternative rule, "delete anything the
# template does not have", would strip every legitimately customer-specific
# file in the fleet.

# Superseded by the template-side Fan-out Template Sync. The per-repo job needs
# an App client id and private key to mint its own token; eight of the derived
# repositories have neither, so it has never been able to run there and shows
# as a permanently failing check. The control plane now pushes sync branches
# in, so the credential — and the workflow that needed it — are both obsolete.
.github/workflows/sync-template.yaml
